# 21 — Create pull-request summary

## Objective
Draft a review-ready PR description for the current scoped change.
## Required context and areas
Inspect diff, linked requirements/risks, tests and actual command output, docs, evidence, and `.github/pull_request_template.md`.
## Change constraints
Draft text only. Do not claim unrun checks passed or omit unresolved questions.
## Response format
Fill the template: purpose, requirement/risk links, tests/results, docs, security/accessibility, AI use, human validation, assumptions, questions, rollback.
## Assumptions
State unknown links and validation limitations.
## Validation and evidence
Verify each assertion against repository evidence and report exact commands/outcomes.
